narrative.overview: Moodeng Stock is designed as an inviting, tactile digital pantry. It borrows the warmth and charm of a kitchen whiteboard and hand-pinned sticky notes, combining pastel softness with clean structure. Rather than overwhelming users with noisy cartoon clutter or cold enterprise grids, the interface balances minimalist order with delightful tactile details. Every surface is purposeful, organized, and optimized for quick one-handed mobile interactions.
keyCharacteristics: Warm Pastel Harmony: Soft blush pinks, cream papers, and soft kitchen blues create an approachable, low-stress environment.
Tactile Chunky Edges: Solid 2px–3px dark ink strokes ground interactive components, recalling wooden toys and stationery.
Balanced Order: Minimalist layout discipline ensures cards align neatly in a responsive 2-column mobile grid.
No-Native Dialogue Doctrine: All feedback uses custom in-app doodle toasts and mascot alerts.

rules.name: The Espresso Outline Rule
rules.body: Never use pitch-black (#000000) for borders or text. Always use Espresso Ink (#3D3329). It preserves warmth while providing strong visual contrast.

rules.name: The Functional Pastel Rule
rules.body: Soft pastels (Piggy, Mint, Honey) are strictly paired with dark ink text. They are never paired with white text unless backed by a high-contrast state token.

rules.name: The Friendly Hand Rule
rules.body: Typography across all levels must consistently use Mali to uphold the handwriting aesthetic.

rules.name: The Ink-Before-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never rely solely on shadow to separate overlapping white-on-paper surfaces. Every card must carry an explicit ink border or distinct background tint.

dos: Do keep action buttons visible at all times on cards to support mobile touch screens.
Do use Espresso Ink (#3D3329) for borders, text, and icons instead of pure black.
Do persist shopping cart and draft state to Local Storage across tab switches.
Do use custom SVG doodle icons and mascot badges for feedback.
donts: Don't invoke native browser dialogs (window.alert, window.confirm, window.prompt).
Don't hide critical buttons behind hover states (group-hover:opacity-100).
Don't introduce pure black (#000000) or cold corporate blue palettes.
Don't stretch item lists into a single wide desktop table; maintain the cozy card grid.
